budget_items.what_was_recorded: The low bid for Library re-carpeting, from seven bids, was Liberty Floor Covering at $46,335; the Assistant Town Manager is soliciting bids for the moving portion.
budget_items.quote: bidderwas liberty floor covering from lincoln, rhodeisland with a bid of$46,335.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A FY21 4th Quarter Water Commitment warrant of $7,560.78 was presented for signature.

budget_items.topic: Pay as you throw bag cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cost of pay-as-you-throw bags will rise under a new contract; the Town will solicit bag vendor bids, which bears on the cost of operating the trash program. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cost of the pay as you throw bags will increase due to the new contract.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The three-year Constellation contract for the Community Choice Power Supply program expires in November at a current rate printed as $.10998; Colonial Power issued an RFP with price proposals due May 17.
budget_items.quote: contract with constellation expires in november (current rate of$.10998).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Student banners and foldable signs on recycling education at the three schools are to be funded by recycling dividends grant funding. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: this will be funded by our recycling dividends grant funding.
